page_note: 本页为IEA《Energy Technology Perspectives 2023》第48页，正文讨论热泵成本，下方是Figure 1.6，由六个小面板柱状图组成，展示NZE情景下若干清洁能源技术2021/2030/2050年的全球部署量。

heading.title: Global deployment of selected clean energy technologies in the NZE Scenario

figures.value_axis_ticks: Electric cars: 0, 30, 60, 90; Fuel cell trucks: 0, 1, 2, 3; Heat pumps: 0, 250, 500, 750; Low-emission electricity: 0, 200, 400, 600, 800; Low-emission hydrogen: 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500; Low-emission synthetic HF: 0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125

components.evidence: six panels of the same bar chart: Electric cars, Fuel cell trucks, Heat pumps, Low-emission electricity, hydrogen, synthetic HF
each panel carries its own bold title above it, e.g. "Heat pumps", "Low-emission hydrogen"
axes read 0-90, 0-3, 0-750, 0-800, 0-500, 0-125 across the six panels
in "Low-emission electricity" two bars (Solar PV, Wind) sit side by side in each year slot
the only legend, "Solar PV  Wind", sits under the Low-emission electricity panel alone
"Solar PV  Wind" legend row drawn below the Low-emission electricity plot area
"Million units/year", "GWth", "GW/year", "Mt/year", "Billion litres/year" set vertically along the axes
bare ticks 0/200/400/600/800 with the scale word only in the rotated axis title "GW/year"
faint horizontal rules at each tick in every panel, no vertical rules
"Notes: HF = hydrocarbon fuels" and "IEA. CC BY 4.0." printed under the figure
the whole figure block behind the six panels carries a faint grey tint rather than white

new_components.name: panel_without_axis_unit
new_components.evidence: "Fuel cell trucks" panel shows ticks 0, 1, 2, 3 with no rotated axis title or unit
new_components.why_it_matters: 该面板的数值单位在图上完全缺失，读出的2.6只能靠正文或外部知识补单位，表格行无法从页面获得单位标签。

new_components.name: subscript_in_axis_unit
new_components.evidence: the Heat pumps axis title is "GWth" with a subscript "th" after GW
new_components.why_it_matters: 解析为纯文本时下标易丢失或变成"GWth"，影响单位标签与数值的对应校验。

new_components.name: near_zero_bar_invisible
new_components.evidence: 2021 bars in Fuel cell trucks, hydrogen and synthetic HF are hairlines at the baseline
new_components.why_it_matters: 这些接近零的柱几乎无高度，无法按5%容差读数，只能报告为约零。

difficulty_notes: 六个面板全部values_printed=none，只能靠像素对轴读数，而刻度间距相对容差过粗：Electric cars刻度间隔30，61的5%容差仅±3，即约刻度间距的1/10；Heat pumps刻度间隔250，600的5%容差±30，约1/8格；Fuel cell trucks刻度间隔1，2.6要读到±0.13。Low-emission electricity中Solar PV 2030(650)与2050(650)高度几乎相同，需在600与800刻度之间精确插值，稍偏即越界。相比之下标签只需2–3个键（面板名+年份+系列），面板名又是加粗小标题，较易被解析捕获。

suggestions.what_to_add: per_panel_axis_range 与面板级单位（新组件 panel_without_axis_unit）
suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中加入"每面板独立轴范围+每面板独立单位，且允许某面板缺单位"的样式字段
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板键是否进入行键：同一图六面板单位各异时，缺panel_key的表格行会把2050的90/2.6/600混为一行

suggestions.what_to_add: per_panel_legend（仅一个面板带图例、其余面板单系列）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图例布局字段：从图级shared_legend扩展为panel-scoped legend
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 系列键仅对部分面板存在时，行键长度不一致对检索命中率的影响

suggestions.what_to_add: rotated_axis_title 与 unit_in_axis_or_title（含下标 GWth）
suggestions.where_to_change: heading/unit 字段：单位位置枚举增加"竖排轴标题"，并保留下标文本
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位只存在于竖排轴标题时，导出表格是否仍能把单位写进列头

suggestions.where_to_change: readable 判定：把每个mark的可达精度改为按柱高像素给出的分级精度
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 高度<2px的mark是否计入评分，及其对整图平均误差的贡献
